ITEM 1 | Brown-grey meat pieces with darker seared edges and glossy sheen, cut into irregular chunks about 4-6 cm long and 1-2 cm thick, arranged in a cluster across the upper and right side of the plate, with some fibrous grain visible | 170
ITEM 2 | Light tan, grainy mixture with small granular pieces and flecks of green and dark specks, moist-looking and loosely clumped, sitting between and under the meat chunks in a mound about 1-2 cm high across the center of the plate | 120
ITEM 3 | Fresh loose leafy greens with bright to dark green ruffled leaves, thin pale stems, and some shredded pale strands, spread over the lower left and lower center of the plate in a mound about 2-3 cm high, slightly wilted and dry-looking | 60
ITEM 4 | Small scattered shreds of thin orange-red strips, about 1-2 cm long, lying on the greens near the lower center edge | 3
ITEM 5 | Small dark red pieces, about 0.5-1 cm, at the left edge of the greens near the rim, possibly a moist bead-like garnish | 2
